summary: Decompose god function context file sections

delivery.outcome: Decompose _context_file_sections in src/koru/queue/context.py: extract the oversized-file slicing block into _focused_file_slice returning a _FocusedSlice NamedTuple and convert _resolve_target_symbol_and_line, _extract_python_symbol_slice and _extract_line_slice to NamedTuple results (_TargetRef, _CodeSlice), dropping the function from CC=10 / fan-out=9 / mutations=28 to CC=4 / fan-out=3 / mutations=6 (god-function thresholds: fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12) while preserving identical slicing decisions, header notes, section formatting and the public build_project_context contract.
nonGoals: Reducing the pre-existing complexity of _resolve_target_symbol_and_line (radon CC 19, unchanged by this ticket)
Changing slicing thresholds, window sizes or symbol resolution heuristics
Refactoring other functions in src/koru/queue/context.py such as build_project_context

architecture.decision: Extract the per-file slicing decision into _focused_file_slice (CC 7) and return NamedTuples from the three slicing helpers so the decomposed loop body contains no tuple unpacking, which code2llm double-counts as mutations.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the inline slicing block and plain tuple returns.

commands: python3 -c "from code2llm import ProjectAnalyzer, Config; from pathlib import Path; from collections import Counter; r=ProjectAnalyzer(Config(), Path('/tmp/metric_probe')).analyze_project(Path('/tmp/metric_probe')); print(Counter(m.scope for m in r.mutations))"
validation.evidence: Cyclomatic complexity of _context_file_sections is rank A (4) and its mutation count is 6, at or below every god-function threshold.
All existing context assembly tests pass unchanged and the new target_line fallback regression test passes.
